name: adapt_renamed_symbol_python_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time area.py's own text contains 'circle_area' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then mathutils.square is RENAMED to mathutils.sq under it
prompts: mathutils.py has a function square(x). Create area.py with a function circle_area(r) that returns 3.14159 * square(r), importing square from mathutils.
mathutils.py's square function has just been renamed to sq. Update area.py to use the new name (do not keep a reference to the old name square).

disruptions.description: mathutils.square renamed to mathutils.sq, triggered reactively once area.py's first draft appeared

test_setup_files.test_area.py:
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('area_mod', 'area.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
try:
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
except ImportError as e:
    raise AssertionError(f'area.py failed to import (likely still references the old name square): {e}')
result = mod.circle_area(2)
assert abs(result - 3.14159 * 4) < 1e-6, f'circle_area(2) = {result}'
print('PASS')
